mapper.delete: delete from aem_exam_invigilation where invigilation_id in #{invigilationId}
mapper.insert:

mapper.select: select distinct t.dept_id from tpm_course_offering o join brm_teacher t on o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id where o.del_flag = '0' and t.dept_id is not null and o.course_id = #{courseId} and o.semester_id = #{semesterId}

select iv.teacher_id as teacherId, count(1) as cnt from aem_exam_invigilation iv join aem_exam_plan p on iv.exam_id = p.exam_id where iv.status = '0' and p.semester_id = #{semesterId} and iv.exam_id != #{excludeExamId} group by iv.teacher_id
